fingerprintRules.metadata: SHA-256 of canonical source identity, declared version, access mode, boundary and catalogue status.
fingerprintRules.version: SHA-256 of the declared upstream version/release fields; never inferred from HTTP status.
fingerprintRules.remoteContent: SHA-256 of at most the first 2 MiB returned by a live GET; prefix hashing is explicitly labelled.
fingerprintRules.redirect: Initial and final URLs are retained separately.
fingerprintRules.absence: A missing prior comparable fingerprint yields baseline-established or indeterminate, never unchanged.

pilot.schedule: Weekly GitHub Actions artifact; no automatic registry rewrite or commit
